verdict.rationale: Modal documents Sandboxes as secure, isolated, ephemeral containers for running untrusted user or agent code. Its docs include an AI-agent example that executes generated code in a Sandbox, plus network isolation controls (block_network, outbound CIDR/domain allowlists, inbound allowlists) and a VM Sandbox option. A live probe confirms the docs page describes 'secure containers for executing untrusted user or agent code.' Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees, and in-pack detail on the underlying isolation mechanism (VM Sandboxes are still beta).
